title_en: An Order Someone Else Can Use

commands.speaker: marek_vane
commands.text: Now pretend I am sitting at the bench. What do you need from me?

commands.speaker: or_volunteer
commands.text: Leave the opening clear. Put the used cloth here, so the clean stack stays clean.

commands.speaker: nara_vell
commands.text: That is an instruction people can follow.

commands.speaker: marek_vane
commands.text: And one I can follow while sitting down. A rare luxury.
The exit remains open. The board holds enough room for another pair of hands.
